participant.fields.name: Your name
participant.dialog.emailHelp: We'll email you your link to change or cancel{reminder, select, yes {, and a reminder before your slot} other {}}. Without an email, save the link we show you after you sign up.
participant.dialog.unreachable.suggestio: Check your connection and try again.
participant.dialog.savedEmailed: We've saved your spot for {slot} and emailed this link to {address}. Bookmark it to edit or cancel later:
participant.dialog.savedNotEmailed: We've saved your spot for {slot}. Save this link now: we won't email it, and only this browser remembers it.{calendar, select, yes { Add to calendar saves the link too.} other {}}
participant.dialog.shareText: My spot for {slot}. This link changes or cancels it, so keep it private.
participant.dialog.copyFailed: Couldn't copy it. Select the link above and copy it yourself.
participant.errors.capacity.filledUp: Sorry, this slot just filled up.
participant.errors.capacity.onlyLeft: Only {remaining, plural, one {{remaining, number, ::group-off} spot is} other {{remaining, number, ::group-off} spots are}} left, and you asked for {requested, number, ::group-off}.

participant.errors.conflict.change: This spot can't be changed any more.

participant.errors.failed.cancel: Something went wrong, so your spot wasn't cancelled.
participant.gonePage.signup.title: Sorry, this signup is no longer available
participant.gonePage.signup.body: Contact the organizer to find out what has changed, or to ask them for a new link.
participant.gonePage.editLink.title: Sorry, this link isn’t working
participant.gonePage.editLink.body: Your spot may no longer be available, or the link may be incomplete. Contact the organizer to find out what has changed. If you got a confirmation email, you can also try its link again.
participant.editPage.title: Your spot
participant.editPage.closedBanner.title: Closed
participant.editPage.closedBanner.body: You can't add more spots now, but you can still change your details, give spots back, or cancel.
participant.editForm.spotsMax: You can have up to {max, plural, one {{max, number, ::group-off} spot} other {{max, number, ::group-off} spots}} on this slot.
participant.editForm.saveUnreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and press Save again.
participant.editForm.saveUnreadable: Something went wrong. Press Save again.
participant.editForm.cancelUnreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and press Cancel signup again.
participant.editForm.cancelUnreadable: Something went wrong. Press Cancel signup again.
participant.cancelledPage.title: Your spot was cancelled
participant.cancelledPage.open: There’s still room if you want to sign up again.
participant.cancelledPage.full: The slot has filled up since.
participant.cancelledPage.removed.title: The organizer took you off this slot
participant.cancelledPage.removed.body: If you think this is a mistake, contact the organizer.
participant.cancelledPage.moved.title: Your spot moved to another slot
participant.cancelledPage.moved.body: You’re still signed up. Use the link below to see or change it.
participant.unsubscribe.title: Reminder emails
participant.unsubscribe.incomplete.title: This link is incomplete
participant.unsubscribe.incomplete.body: Unsubscribe links only work in full. Open the link straight from your reminder email, or reply to the organizer to ask them to stop.
participant.unsubscribe.invalid.title: This link isn't valid
participant.unsubscribe.invalid.body: It may have been mangled in transit, or the signup may have been deleted. Open the link straight from your reminder email, or reply to the organizer to ask them to stop.
participant.unsubscribe.confirm.title: Stop reminder emails?
participant.unsubscribe.confirm.body: We'll stop sending reminders for {title}, and emails when the organizer changes your slot's date or time. This only affects this signup, and your slot stays as it is.
participant.unsubscribe.confirm.bodyWith: We'll stop sending {email} reminders for {title}, and emails when the organizer changes your slot's date or time. This only affects this signup, and your slot stays as it is.
participant.unsubscribe.turnOffFailed: We couldn't turn off your reminders. Please try again.
participant.unsubscribe.turnedOff.title: Reminders turned off
participant.unsubscribe.turnedOff.body: You won't get any more reminders for {title}, or emails when the organizer changes your slot's date or time. Your slot is unchanged — if you also want to give it up, open the link in your confirmation email and cancel there.
participant.unsubscribe.areOff.title: Reminders are off
participant.unsubscribe.areOff.body: Reminders for {title} are off. You won't get reminders about it, or emails when the organizer changes your slot's date or time.
participant.unsubscribe.areOff.bodyWithE: Reminders for {title} are off for {email}. You won't get reminders about it, or emails when the organizer changes your slot's date or time.
participant.unsubscribe.turnOnFailed: We couldn't turn your reminders back on. Please try again.
participant.unsubscribe.turnedOn.title: Reminders turned back on
participant.unsubscribe.turnedOn.body: You'll get reminders for {title} again, and emails when your slot's date or time changes. You can stop them any time from the link in one.
participant.unsubscribe.turnedOn.bodyWit: You'll get reminders for {title} again at {email}, and emails when your slot's date or time changes. You can stop them any time from the link in one.
email.common.stillConfirmed: You'll still get a confirmation if you sign up for something new.
email.confirmation.heading: You're signed up
email.confirmation.keep: Keep this email. The button above is how you change or cancel later, with no password to remember. Anyone with that link can change your slot, so don't forward it.{reminder, select, yes { We'll also send you a reminder {hours, plural, =24 {the day before} one {# hour before} other {# hours before}}.} other {}}
email.reminder.heading: Coming up
email.reminder.intro: Hi {name}, this is a reminder that you signed up for {title}.
email.reminder.changed.heading: Your slot has changed
email.reminder.changed.intro: Hi {name}, the organizer changed your slot for {title} since we last emailed you. Here are the new details.
email.reminder.keep: Need to change or cancel? Tap the button above. It opens your spot directly, no password needed. Keep this email to yourself: anyone with the link can change your slot.
email.slotChanged.heading: Your slot has changed
email.slotChanged.intro: Hi {name}, the organizer of {title} moved your slot to a new date or time. Here are the new details.
email.slotChanged.keep: Can't make the new time? Tap the button above to change or cancel. It opens your spot directly, no password needed. Keep this email to yourself: anyone with the link can change your slot.
